study type: Prospective interventional study (ancillary to a clinical trial)
outcome: Urinary metabolome (galactose, carnitine, choline, lysine, leucine)
cohort: Preterm and very low-birth weight infants receiving human milk fortified with either bovine or donkey milk-based fortifiers.
finding: Isocaloric and isoproteic human milk fortification using different fortifier protein sources (bovine vs. donkey milk-based) leads to distinct urinary metabolic patterns in preterm and VLBW infants, specifically higher galactose excretion with D-HMF and higher carnitine, choline, lysine, and leucine excretion with B-HMF.
